messages:
Sam: Heads-up — spotted a weird jump in NDCG@10 for the long-context slice after we bumped the default context window for reranker-v2 in staging. Wasn't present yesterday. :thinking:
Anika: Can you paste the slice numbers? short/mid/long?
Sam: Quick paste from nightly: ndcg@10: short=0.512, mid=0.534, long=0.641 (previously ~0.535). MRR@10: short=0.278, mid=0.291, long=0.312. The long slice jump looks suspiciously high compared to baseline.
Miguel: That's huge. Did we change truncation/tokenization boundaries when increasing context? Could be that long docs now include extra anchor text that helps the model.
Anika: I checked the preproc diff — we switched from doc-truncate-from-end -> doc-truncate-preserve-sentences for long docs in the bringup PR. Might explain added signal.
Priya: But evaluation harness should match production preproc. Are we comparing apples-to-apples? Which dataset split did nightly use?
Sam: Nightly used rankbench-v3 holdout (same as prod), but I remembered we switched the offline prefix-cache sim that pads context to sequence length for long docs in staging only.
Miguel: Two hypotheses: 1) added padding/prefixing gives extra priming tokens that boost long-doc relevance artificially, 2) candidate ordering change where snippets from same doc are now concatenated and model sees more context.
Anika: Repro steps I'm running now:
```
# local repro (short)
rbench run --model reranker-v2 --split holdout --slice length_bucket --buckets short,mid,long --seed 42 --preproc=staging
```
Sam: ops-bot posted the quick reg-run earlier: ops-bot: nightly-rerank-bench finished: delta_ndcg_long=+0.106, note=preproc=staging-sentence-preserve, quant=int8-disabled
Priya: OK enabled/disabled experiments we should run: keep preproc old vs new, preserve candidate boundaries vs concat, and quantized vs fp16. Also check whether idremapping during dedupe changed candidate ranks.
Miguel: One more thing — when context length grows model might rely on recency bias in long docs; that could inflate NDCG but not true relevance. We should check human-labelled subset.
Anika: Running small human-gold subset now (200 queries) with both preproc variants. Will post numbers.
Sam: If this is an artifact of staging preproc we should revert patch and gate on explicit eval pass. No rollout until we understand.
Priya: Agreed. Also flagging this to quality gating: test->ndcg-long-slice spike > 0.05 triggers manual review.
Anika: Quick interim results: human-subset ndcg@10: old-preproc=0.548, new-preproc=0.551 (tiny change), but offline batch (full holdout) shows big jump. Means sampling/candidate list differences are amplifying effect.
Miguel: That points to candidate curation difference, not model capability. Maybe dedupe removed near-duplicates in mid/short but kept long docs causing longer docs to dominate topk.
Sam: Action items: (1) Anika to diff candidate pools (2) Priya to re-run bench with old candidate curation + new preproc (3) Miguel to audit dedupe/tokenization changes. I'll hold the staging promotion.
Anika: Yep working on candidate pool diff now, will paste sample lists.
ops-bot: CI-note: rerank-ci-tests queued; will run with param set {preproc:old,new; dedupe:on,off} and report when done.
Priya: Thanks — if anyone sees this oncall ping me. :eyes:
Sam: Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates.
